title: World editor button freezes on tap and never opens on iPhone
reproduction: Confirm Kelo Studio chrome appears immediately instead of a frozen World card.
Confirm the editor becomes interactive (tools/status, not only the loading shell).
Close/remove the Studio shell or reproduce the stale-session condition.
Open Create -> World again and confirm Studio remounts instead of black-screening.
expected: World opens, remains interactive, and can be reopened even after a stale Studio shell/session condition.

fix.summary: 5a52c6d handoff failed player QA (loading chrome then black Safari tab). New world-light candidate: keep Hub until .ks-status and restore it if the editor never mounts; Studio extras/palette load after core; live controller dynamically imports studio-entry; shell paints before world import; overlay dpr capped at 1.5 on iPhone and allocated after chrome.

verification.method: Real iPhone Safari E2E: enter game -> Create -> World -> Studio chrome visible immediately, then interactive tools/status, not a black Safari tab. Do not mark PASS from headless_shell. 824a932 and 5a52c6d both failed this method.

notes: Visibility of a loading #kelo-studio-live is not sufficient acceptance; .ks-status / tools must appear and respond to touch.
Do not mark VERIFIED until the deployed flow passes on the target device class.
Studio graph must stay lazy until World is tapped (live-studio-click-audit).
headless_shell can freeze after Studio mounts because of the overlay canvas loop; that is not the player-facing Hub-cover bug.
